tools.name: kumitate_validate
tools.description: Check a CircleCI config.yml (2.1): YAML, structure, parameters, executors, commands, jobs and workflows, with named refusals. Orbs are refused as unresolved: nothing is fetched.

tools.name: kumitate_plan
tools.description: The processed pipeline of a config: parameters bound, matrix jobs expanded, filters and when/unless decided, the workflow DAG with levels, parallel jobs and containers. Nothing runs.

config.description: The text of .circleci/config.yml (version 2.1), up to 5 MiB.

branch.description: The branch the pipeline is for: decides branch filters and << pipeline.git.branch >>.

tag.description: The tag the pipeline is for: decides tag filters and << pipeline.git.tag >>.

parameters.description: Pipeline parameter values by name; declared types are checked (a boolean is JSON true/false).

values.description: Other << pipeline.* >> values by their full name, e.g. {"pipeline.number": 7}. Values not given stay as written, with a warning.

tools.name: kumitate_process
tools.description: The processed config as YAML (version 2), like `circleci config process`: commands and executors expanded, << >> substituted, matrix jobs named.

config.description: The text of .circleci/config.yml (version 2.1), up to 5 MiB.

branch.description: The branch the pipeline is for: decides branch filters and << pipeline.git.branch >>.

tag.description: The tag the pipeline is for: decides tag filters and << pipeline.git.tag >>.

parameters.description: Pipeline parameter values by name; declared types are checked (a boolean is JSON true/false).

values.description: Other << pipeline.* >> values by their full name, e.g. {"pipeline.number": 7}. Values not given stay as written, with a warning.

tools.name: kumitate_api_shapes
tools.description: The CircleCI API v2 Pipeline, Workflow and Job objects this config would show when the pipeline is created (statuses from the API's enums). Ids derive from project_slug, number and created_at; nothing is sent to circleci.com.

config.description: The text of .circleci/config.yml (version 2.1), up to 5 MiB.

branch.description: The branch the pipeline is for: decides branch filters and << pipeline.git.branch >>.

tag.description: The tag the pipeline is for: decides tag filters and << pipeline.git.tag >>.

parameters.description: Pipeline parameter values by name; declared types are checked (a boolean is JSON true/false).

values.description: Other << pipeline.* >> values by their full name, e.g. {"pipeline.number": 7}. Values not given stay as written, with a warning.

tools.name: kumitate_local_plan
tools.description: The steps of each job that would run, in DAG order, for running them yourself on your own machine. kumitate executes nothing.

config.description: The text of .circleci/config.yml (version 2.1), up to 5 MiB.

branch.description: The branch the pipeline is for: decides branch filters and << pipeline.git.branch >>.

tag.description: The tag the pipeline is for: decides tag filters and << pipeline.git.tag >>.

parameters.description: Pipeline parameter values by name; declared types are checked (a boolean is JSON true/false).

values.description: Other << pipeline.* >> values by their full name, e.g. {"pipeline.number": 7}. Values not given stay as written, with a warning.

tools.name: kumitate_runs
tools.description: Read CircleCI run records the user already holds (kumitate.runs.v1, an API v2 items page of workflows or jobs, or {workflows, jobs}) and summarize: statuses, failed jobs, success rate and mean duration per job, flaky jobs.

tools.name: kumitate_runs_export
tools.description: Write a normalized run record (kumitate_runs's record) as kumitate.runs.v1 JSON or as CircleCI API v2 items pages. Reading the result again gives the same record.

tools.name: kumitate_junit
tools.description: Aggregate JUnit XML test reports (one a run): totals per report, failing tests, flaky tests (passed in one run, failed in another) and the slowest tests. No DTD or external entity is read.
